title: Android Playback Session Integrity
problem: Android can request Direct Play and has playback session clients, but remux/HLS session identity is not carried into the player lifecycle.
summary: Closed lane that made server-owned remux/HLS playback sessions a public Android smoke contract and split active runtime cancellation smoke as a follow-on.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-api -p nako-client -p nako-server playback

evidence.notes: Lane opened and first session identity bridge target frozen.
Public remux/HLS playback session identity bridge implemented and verified across Rust Public Client API, TypeScript SDK, server routes, and Android playback target preparation.
profile-with-media smoke created a public remux session via HEAD preflight and read it back through Public Client API after Android player exit.

Player-exit side effects are test-covered: unfinished playback with a session id reports progress and requests session cancellation; active remux/HLS runtime cancellation smoke is split as a follow-on.

continue_policy.notes: Closed. Follow-on: add a deliberate long-media or non-Direct runtime fixture to prove active remux/HLS player cancellation through Public Client API.
